title: The Seven-Minute Mission
clue: A torn map, four checkpoints and one X somewhere in the apartment.
reveal: Your dog earns the pieces of a torn map by checking in at four spots around home, each with a short dash between them. When the map is whole, it leads to the X: a mat with a hidden prize waiting.
objective: Collect four map pieces by checking in at four spots at home, then follow the finished map to the prize.
instructions: Draw a rough floor plan of your home on a sheet of paper and mark an X on the extraction spot, such as a mat in a corner. Tear the paper into four pieces. Put a favorite toy under a towel on the X, out of sight.

Set four checkpoints on non-slip floor: a mat, a towel, a rug corner and a chair leg. Tape one map piece face down at each, within reach of you but not the dog. Keep the dash between checkpoints at 8 to 15 steps, clear of furniture.
Brief your dog: sit at checkpoint one and say 'mission' in a soft voice. Start your phone's silent timer for seven minutes. It is only a clock, not a deadline.
Check-in: a checkpoint clears when your dog steps on, sniffs or lies near it, in their own way. Say 'yes' and toss a treat toward the next checkpoint, then walk there together. Do not point.
Make it easier if they stall: place a treat on the checkpoint, wait a few seconds or sit nearer. A checkpoint cleared with help still counts.
After the fourth piece, tape the map together on the floor. Read the X aloud and walk your dog there at your own pace.
Extraction: lift the towel at the X, let them have the prize toy and sit quietly with them. If the clock runs out, the mission continues; no penalty.
twist: The mission is a map: four checkpoints each unlock a torn piece, and the whole map is the reveal that leads to the prize.
variations: Easier: two checkpoints, three map pieces and no timer.
Small-space version: put the checkpoints in one room, five steps apart.
Seated owner: tape the pieces to the arms of the chair and toss the treats from your seat.
Hall-free version: use a tray of towels placed in a circle and skip the dashes.
completion: It counts once the map is whole and your dog has reached the X, or when your dog leaves the mission.
photoIdea: The assembled map on the floor with your dog's nose at the X, shot from above.
memoryPrompt: Which checkpoint took longest, and how did your dog reach the X?
dietNotes: Tiny treats from the day's ration; check labels for xylitol and ask your vet about diet limits.
safety: Non-slip floors only; put mats on smooth floors and keep dashes short and clear.
Take away any tape or paper your dog chews, and use treats from the day's ration.
The timer is a clock, not a deadline; end the mission if your dog loses interest.
